item.title: Catching Bugs Before They Land: JiTTesting’s Human-on-the-Loop Approach at Full Scale
item.description: Over the last year we’ve been sharing our work leveraging large language models to catch bugs on the fly — a novel approach we call Catching Just-in-Time Tests (JiTTests) Now, we’re sharing the results and positive impact we’ve seen with Catching JiTTests deployed into production Our paper, “Just-in-Time Catching Test Generation at Meta,” fully details [...] Read More
